'''Calvin Wright (Chapter 1)''' is a special [[ally]] used in scenarios 1-5 of the 2nd Arkham League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Sneak]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

Reduce all [[Sanity]] loss by 1. Calvin may not be sacrificed for any reason.

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Calvin Wright ally used by different scenarios.

[[Category:Allies]]

==Appearances==
Calvin Wright (Chapter 1) appears in the following scenarios:
*[[Calvin Comes To Town]]
*[[The Madness Continues]]
*[[Strength in Numbers]]
*[[Lodge Members Held For Questioning]]
*[[Waves of Madness]]
